action.objective: Move the king to c2 to escape the rook and bishop pressure, keep the king on a safe dark square, and preserve the rook on d2.
action.rationale: h1d1 is refuted: after ...Rb1+ the king cannot escape and ...Rb2 mates. c1c2 verified clean at depth 3-4 with no immediate mate or checking-chain refutation; it also gains the best exact comparison among available verified moves and steps the king off the b-file pin while defending d2.
